name: ICEW World Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Crowned in a same-night tournament final and defended once before this wave's own record runs out — the lighter of ICEW's two weight-class belts, held throughout by the same man.
notes: No reign before Jeff "Madfox" Matthews' own survives; none is attested.

name: ICEW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: ICEW's top title, crowned the same night as the Cruiserweight belt and defended once, via a rematch the fed's own broadcast staged as a screwy-finish restart after a manager's ringside protest.
notes: The 31 August defense restarted the same match against the same challenger (Glenn Skiba) after an in-fiction referee-and-manager controversy; this is read as one continuous title defense, not two.

name: ICEW Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Created and awarded in a single ten-man battle royal that outlasted a mid-match unmasking — ICEW's third and last title crowned in this wave's own record.
notes: Contested by Dylan Dice, Poe, Killa, Jason Starr, Mike Madland (as the masked "Deathbringer," unmasked mid-match), the Executioner, Joel Gutman, Vile Vince Viper, LOCO and Matt Howard.
